Asset.title: Asset
Asset.description: A company-owned item issued to employees (laptop, telefoon, voertuig, gereedschap, toegangspas, kleding, overig): identity fields (serienummer, kenteken for vehicles), acquisition fields, and a guarded custody state machine (asset-management-mvp). A voertuig Asset carries its kenteken and nothing fiscal -- bijtelling automation is explicitly out of scope (engine-blocked per Spectr hrmq-canon-fleet-bijtelling; follow-up spec fleet-bijtelling). No AssetHistoryEntry: OpenRegister's object audit trail already records every mutation.

uitgeven.description: The asset is handed to an employee (recorded by an AssetAssignment with a matching uitgifteDatum).

innemen.description: The asset is returned and awaiting check. Deliberately the only exit from uitgegeven -- an issued asset must be taken in (or its loss recorded here) before it can be written off.

vrijgeven.description: Checked and back in stock, re-issuable via uitgeven.

afschrijven.description: Written off. Terminal. Not reachable from uitgegeven by design (design.md D1).

category.title: Category
category.description: Kind of asset. Enum append-only: renaming a value later is breaking, adding one is not.

serienummer.title: Serienummer
serienummer.description: Serial number; null for uncoded items (kleding, toegangspas).

kenteken.title: Kenteken
kenteken.description: Dutch licence plate -- meaningful for category voertuig. Carries no fiscal semantics; bijtelling is an explicit non-goal (Spectr hrmq-canon-fleet-bijtelling).

status.title: Status
status.description: Custody lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (beschikbaar -> uitgegeven -> ingenomen -> beschikbaar, or beschikbaar/ingenomen -> afgeschreven, terminal).

active.title: Active
active.description: Administrative visibility toggle (the OrgUnit convention), distinct from the custody lifecycle.

AssetAssignment.title: Asset assignment
AssetAssignment.description: An effective-dated uitgifte of one Asset to one Employee (the OrgAssignment pattern, hr-org.json): uitgifteDatum required, innameDatum nullable = the asset is still out. No x-openregister-lifecycle: a plain effective-dated record, no workflow. Consistency (coherent dates, the asset in status uitgegeven while the uitgifte is open) is enforced by nl-asset-assignment-consistency (lib/Standards/rules/labour.json / lib/Standards/Checks/NlAssetChecks.php), not by a write-time guard.

assetId.title: Asset
assetId.description: UUID reference to the issued Asset.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: UUID reference to the receiving Employee.

uitgifteDatum.title: Uitgiftedatum
uitgifteDatum.description: Issued on (effective-dating per the OrgAssignment pattern).

innameDatum.title: Innamedatum
innameDatum.description: Returned on; null while the asset is out. Must be on/after uitgifteDatum when present (nl-asset-assignment-consistency).

uitgifteBonSigned.title: Uitgiftebon getekend
uitgifteBonSigned.description: Whether a signed uitgiftebon is on file (the document itself lives in AssetDetail's Files widget).
